# Tactil

> Custom web design and development studio based in Barcelona, building fast, bespoke websites for businesses worldwide.

## Overview

Tactil is a web design and development agency specialising in 100% custom-built websites - no templates, no WordPress. Every site is hand-coded, optimised for speed, SEO, and conversion. Based in Barcelona, Spain.

## Services

- **Landing Page** - High-converting single-page site, delivered in 5–7 days. From EUR 499.
- **Business Website** - Multi-page professional presence (up to 5 pages), delivered in 2–3 weeks. From EUR 699.
- **Custom Development** - E-commerce, booking systems, web apps, platforms. Custom pricing.

## Key Facts

- Location: Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain
- Average delivery: 7 days (landing pages), 2–3 weeks (full sites)
- Performance: 100/100 Google Lighthouse on every project
- Projects delivered: 50+
- Support: 30 days free after launch
- No templates, no lock-in - full ownership handed to client
- Languages: English, Spanish (Castilian), Catalan, Italian
